'''Weilin Aldragoran''' is a merchant born in [[Malkier]] who resides in [[Saldaea]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Weilin Aldragoran}} His wife is [[Alida]].

== Appearance ==
He is growing a bit soft around the stomach. He wears the ''[[hadori]]''.

== History ==
He was a toddler when the [[Trolloc]]s wiped out Malkier. He must have escaped and now lives in [[Saldaea]]. 

== Activities ==
[[Nynaeve al'Meara]] visits him in Saldaea telling him that the [[Golden Crane]] has been raised and that [[Lan Mandragoran]] rides into the [[Blight]]. Aldragoran decrees that Lan will not ride alone.

He sells everything he owns to purchase supplies for Lan's company. He catches up with Lan close to the border of [[Arafel]] and is introduced to him by [[Andere]]. Lan grudgingly accepts him into the group only if he swears not to reveal who Lan is.
